का.आ. 1303(अ).—केन्द्रीय सरकार, कंपनी (संिोधन) अजधजनयम, 2020 (2020 का 29) की धारा 1 की उप-धारा (2) 

द्वारा प्रित्त िजियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, 24 माचय, 2021 को उस तारीख के रूप में जनयत करती है जिस तारीख को उि अजधजनयम

MINISTRY OF CORPORATE AFFAIRS 

NOTIFICATION 

New Delhi, the 24th March, 2021 

S.O. 1303(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (2) of section 1 of the Companies 

(Amendment) Act, 2020 (29 of 2020), the Central Government hereby appoints the 24
th

 March, 2021 as the date on 

which the provisions of section 23 and  section 45 of the said Act shall come into force.
